more_info.overview: This entry describes polymers containing oxyethylene and oxypropylene units. Their properties depend on the relative amounts, chain lengths and arrangement of these units. FDA defines particular block-copolymer preparations for specific surface-active food applications, including a wetting preparation used with fumaric acid in fruit-flavoured drinks. Such a specification identifies one preparation; it does not define a single composition or food-use permission for every polymer in this broad entry.
more_info.banned_in:
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
EU and US food-additive permissions for this exact entry were not confirmed in the sources checked in 2026.
